variants.headline: Strike collapses
variants.body: A strike has collapsed in {colony}. Working people's needs belong at the centre of this discussion, rather than outside its political argument.

variants.headline: Labour action loses its course
variants.body: The colony has seen a strike collapse. Working people's needs belong at the centre of this discussion, rather than outside its political argument.

variants.headline: A strike ends in collapse
variants.body: A strike in the colony has ended in collapse. Working people's needs belong at the centre of this discussion, rather than outside its political argument.
